name: Pokopoko Gunshou 2 ~It's a Real World~
original_name: ぽこぽこ軍将2～いっつ・あ・りある・わ～るど～
source:
Select opponents in military shogi game and defeat cute girls! There are both familiar faces of heroines and new ones. Difficulty is up due to doubling the board size.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在军人将棋中选择对手，击败可爱的女孩！女主角阵容既有熟悉面孔，也有全新角色。由于棋盘面积扩大一倍，游戏难度也随之提升。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
